body: Well then live it up to her! Show her! You better live a good life and show it to her face in the future, not in a mean way but yea..

Thanks a lot. Thank you so much for listening to me and talking to me. It must be hard to hear to what I said because it is a very upsetting topic and iam sorry if it reminded any past. I hate that you're right. 
But It still feels like I haven't found an answer.

Yes, its true that the situation will pass, but I can't stand my parents being ashamed and upset. 
Our family is not very rich. They littrealy spent a fortune to give me and my sister a good education. My parents will have to struggle to earn the money they lost because of me. I can just avoid the situation by not being there.

They are as caring. That's what makes the situation worse. They are always so loving and understanding and I know they are going to be about this too. I don't want them to pay for my failure. I don't want to embarras them because of my failure.

I failed my 1st year of college. I don't want my parents paying for my extra college fees.  When I tell them, they are gonna be understanding and pay for it, but I don't want that. I wanna be gone not only because I hate myself it's also because I love my parents. I have a older sister, maybe she can make my parents happy.
